notes:
• Smoother taskbar and Dock icons, in both macOS and Windows mode. Opening an app makes its icon grow and fade in, and closing an app makes it shrink and fade out. The other icons slide to their new places instead of jumping. In macOS mode the Dock background also widens and narrows smoothly.
• Fixed: the macOS Dock could flicker, with icons jumping sideways for a moment, when its size changed.
• Fixed: switching between macOS and Windows could flash the HyperOS navigation bar and rebuild the Dock several times, so icons and the back button appeared and disappeared.
• Smoother end of the "Switching appearance…" screen. It now fades out instead of vanishing all at once, and the Dock and menu bar fade in with it.
• The Dock menu now shows "Remove from Dock" / "Pin to Dock" in English when the app language is English.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.
